scope: Trusted ingress for a configured physical personalization bureau using the released Python raw-body HMAC callback. This does not select a provider or enable a public route.

route.public_gateway_owner: provider ingress only when explicitly selected; otherwise preserve existing route ownership

provider_authentication.profile_selection: Resolve exactly one provider profile from a trusted deployment binding or a trusted route binding before verifying the MAC. Never select a profile by callback JSON, query string, or caller-supplied header.
provider_authentication.profile: The selected provider profile supplies the bureau webhook secret reference and provider_profile_id; neither value is accepted from callback JSON.
provider_authentication.algorithm: HMAC-SHA256 over the exact HTTP body bytes, with the provider's UTF-8 shared secret
provider_authentication.signature_encoding: 64 lowercase ASCII hexadecimal characters without a prefix
provider_authentication.comparison: constant-time comparison of decoded MAC bytes
provider_authentication.invalid_or_missing_signature: reject before JSON parsing or database lookup

event_projection.metadata: Preserve released Python projection of fields other than bureau_job_id and status, excluding organization_id from copied metadata and subject to native callback body and field bounds.
event_projection.untrusted_organization_id: The durable job is the sole source of organization_id. If the bureau body includes organization_id and it differs from the durable job, reject without KMS signing. If it matches, ignore that field and do not copy it as metadata. Never use a bureau-supplied organization_id to select a tenant or form the internal signed event.

job_resolution.durable_binding: Persist provider_profile_id with the physical document job at submission. Require a unique non-null (provider_profile_id, bureau_job_id) mapping for ingress-eligible jobs; audit existing duplicates before adding the constraint.
job_resolution.tenant_source: Read organization_id only from the uniquely matched durable job after provider HMAC verification.
job_resolution.zero_or_multiple_matches: Fail closed without requesting KMS signing or changing any job.
job_resolution.provider_mismatch: Fail closed without revealing a foreign organization_id or whether another provider owns the bureau_job_id.
job_resolution.native_recheck: The existing native repository must still match both signed organization_id and bureau_job_id, and reject ambiguity within that tenant.

internal_handoff.body: Construct a new JSON callback from the trusted durable organization_id, signed bureau_job_id, status, and allowed metadata. The exact newly serialized bytes must be used for both KMS signing and native delivery.
internal_handoff.signer: Use the shared Rust passport callback signer implementation through an isolated signer process with a narrowly scoped internal service credential and private signing network. No public caller or bureau receives this credential or an OpenBao token.
internal_handoff.signed_input: base64(UTF8(marty.passport-bureau-callback/v1) || NUL || UTF8(durable organization_id) || NUL || exact internal callback body bytes)
internal_handoff.kms_failure: Fail closed without direct repository update or legacy-secret fallback.

deployment_gate.existing_beta_signer: The existing passport-callback-signer process and Compose network are beta-only; they do not qualify base, selfhost, or K8s production-mode consumers.
deployment_gate.required_before_python_retirement: For each accepted base, selfhost, and K8s environment, separately review and deploy an isolated KMS callback signer process using the same shared Rust implementation. Prove a narrow signer credential and KMS key policy, a private signer-to-ingress network, no public sign route, and no OpenBao token exposure to the bureau or public ingress before marty-credentials #305 cutover.
deployment_gate.default: No physical bureau ingress or production-mode callback signer is enabled by this contract.

response_boundary.unauthenticated: Never parse or look up a job; return no tenant or job details.
response_boundary.authenticated_unresolved: Return one generic unresolved response for missing, ambiguous, or provider-mismatched jobs; include no tenant or foreign-provider data.
response_boundary.logs: Do not log raw body, signature, shared secret, internal service credential, OpenBao token, or organization_id in external errors.

forged_organization_id_case.outcome: reject without KMS signing or job mutation

fail_closed_cases: missing, empty, non-hex, uppercase, prefixed, wrong-length, or mismatched provider signature
one-byte raw-body mutation after provider signing
empty or over-limit body; malformed JSON; missing bureau_job_id or status; unknown status
bureau-supplied organization_id differs from the durable tenant
signer authentication failure, malformed vault signature, KMS outage, or native callback rejection
duplicate or stale delivery must obey the existing native progress contract
